name: Takahara Mia
source:
An employee of the company [url=/c11597]Saki’s[/url] father runs, she is currently under company orders to act as Saki’s chaperon. 

Driving away the pesky insects who approach Saki is part of her job, and towards her greatest enemy at the moment, [url=/c11601]Tooru[/url], she harbors mixed feelings of trust and hostility.

[Based on [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180616215827/https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1064]Mangagamer[/url]]
